security.gateDesc: Turn on only the trust signals you want. Members must satisfy every enabled requirement before they can participate.
security.reqEmailDesc: Account must have a confirmed email address.
security.reqPhoneDesc: Account must have a confirmed phone number.
security.req2faDesc: Two-factor authentication must be enabled on the account.
security.reqMatureDesc: Account must meet minimum age / standing (platform policy).
security.allowGuestsDesc: When off, only signed-in members matching your gate can use the server. When on, guests may access allowed surfaces (e.g. public preview) per product rules.
security.howDesc: Each enabled option adds a requirement. For example, email + phone + 2FA means all three must be true. Enforcement in chat and joins is applied by the server when those features are wired to this policy.
